notes: Both object markers (s021, s025) are unrepresented; the ASV writes 'all the land' and 'Gilead' bare (rule 16).

עַל־פְּנֵי is fused as 'over against' with the relative clause's supplied copula (rules 30, 49), source head on the construct noun (rule 23) and target head on 'over' (rule 24); the competing reading would split 'over' onto the preposition and 'against' onto the construct, but no morpheme owns either word separately.
The single 'the' of 'to the top of Pisgah' is the article s011's, fronted from a rectum the ASV renders anarthrously (rule 29); the supplied 'to' is the appositional nominal's own under rule 33.

The supplied 'of' before Gilead is read as the appositive's rendering, the ASV having recast the second accusative as a genitive of 'land'; the competing reading would give it to the object marker s025, but rule 16's families cover an object relation and this word states the relation between the two nouns.
